title: Container access plugin
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `apps/console-web/plugins/container-access` (`ai.amberx.axf.console.container-access`). The only console code that touches other containers, through `axf-docker-proxy` (haproxy, `deploy/haproxy.cfg` in the plugin: list/inspect, archive GET/HEAD/PUT, exec, restart only; everything else 403), started

commits.message: Add the Container access plugin: locked-down Docker socket proxy, server-side protected list, audit log and approval-gated change batches (axf.containers@1)
Add the Snapshot Manager plugin: snapshots before every approved change, diff, one-step restore (itself undoable), retention 30 days / 5 GB (axf.snapshots@1)

Add the Terminal plugin: floating terminal tabs for containers, the console, the VPS host and Claude Code, Open terminal on every right-click, mouse mode, copy/paste, Mosh mode with server-kept sessio

Independent review fixes: Claude Code CLI gets no secrets and can't read /proc or the console's private folder; exact base hashes for big files, explicit accept for changes the card can't show, comman
Fix console installer stopping after removing the container (wall on)
Fix console start: empty docker run arg from container-access host.sh
